### BIG Kodak film roll – Pen holder & storage box

Turn one of the most iconic symbols of analog photography into a fun and practical oversized desk accessory!

This BIG Kodak Film Roll is a giant version of the classic Kodak film roll, redesigned as a useful and eye-catching container. It can be used as a Pen Holder, Pencil Case, Storage Box or Organizer, making it perfect for your desk, studio or workspace.

The Iconic Design of the classic Kodak film roll makes this model both functional and decorative. Its oversized shape gives it a unique look and makes it a great choice for anyone who loves turning everyday objects into giant statement pieces.

 

Use it as:

* ✏️ Pen Holder for pens, pencils and markers
* 🖊️ Pencil Case for stationery
* 📦 Storage Box for small items
* 🗂️ Organizer for your desk
* 🎁 A fun decorative piece or gift idea
The model is designed to be Durable & Sturdy.

A practical yet eye-catching design that brings a retro photography touch to your desk!

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 8% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 8%
- Filament: PLA (#000000), PLA (#FEC600), PLA (#5F6367)
